literal_glyph_notes: p104 D has 149 typed coordinates against RICHI-150. Its row 3 group ADAG contains four coordinates. All five insertions within that group are priced against the full conditional reading. Boundaries102 and103 each supply A with zero observed-coordinate substitutions; they yield the same complete ciphertext and plaintext but different raw uncertain positions.
p104 E3 retains the printed C-like glyphs in GAAXC and GXAVC as noncoordinate C observations, at source indices39 and119. One is filled for JAEG; the other remains unresolved in the unit field.
The light marginal dash before p105 C1 row5 and comma-like punctuation after p104 E3 GGDDF are recorded as annotations, not typed coordinate slots. They are visible in the bound crops.
limits: The unchanged Nov1–3 square supplies labels, not an independently authenticated numeral interpretation.
The three-part p105/p106 reading is supported by matching source headers; p104 A3 is a near-copy whose 1/11 date and reference104359 conflict with the other copy and are not overwritten.
The p104 D recovery is conditional on one missing coordinate within the visibly short source group. Two gap alignments produce exactly the same completed ciphertext.
The p104 E3 battalion field remains one unresolved plaintext position. The p104 B literals5UKS, NSM and6NKJ are not silently normalized.
Earlier exploratory repository candidates identified the bodies; this edition adds visual source correction, multipart linkage and exact local short-group recovery without a first-solution assertion.
